name: China Meheco Group Co., Ltd.
summary: China Meheco Group Co., Ltd. operates in pharmaceutical industry in China and internationally. The company is involved in international trade of pharmaceuticals, including pharmaceutical preparations, drug substances, intermediates, medical devices, medical consumables, Chinese medicinal materials, and extracts; and pharmaceutical commerce business.
